author: PC Gamer
text:
Celebrate Labor Day by playing Civilization 7 for free
There's actually no connection to Labor Day that I can see, but Civ 7 is free to play until September 10, and it's on sale too.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'Grand Theft Auto is a videogame franchise built around criminal activity': Miami-Dade County Sheriff comes out hard against a proposed GTA 6 collab with Rockstar
It actually sounds like a really good idea, but of course the cops are against it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
After a massive 2021 office expansion, Bungie is now trying to sublease its 211,000 square foot headquarters
Bungie says it "will continue to maintain a physical office presence in Bellevue."

author: PC Gamer
text:
The White House launches online 'arcade' with its own takes on Tetris and other popular games, and it's as rotten as you'd expect
The arcade currently includes games based on Tetris, Flappy Bird, and Snake, and of course a healthy dose of racism and pro-Trump propaganda.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Me: You can now run DLSS 5 on AMD GPUs. My RX 9070 XT: Please stop, it hurts us
A new app allows you to inject DLSS Neural Rendering deep into games even if you're running an AMD card. You probably won't want to, though.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Blood of Dawnwalker endings and how to get each one
Decide the fate of Vale Sangora and free Coen's family.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I have filled GTA 5 with realistic Los Angeles snow
Chestnuts roasting on an open car-fire.

author: PC Gamer
text:
A popular streamer turned down a 6-figure deal to play Arc Raiders because 'the game frustrated me so much'
Seven-figures? Now we're talking.

author: PC Gamer
text:
D&D is getting a Netflix series about Strahd, involving the director of The Prisoner of Azkaban, and I honestly think this could work great
I've been hankering after a Curse of Strahd adaptation for a long time.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Great, now motherboard prices might be next to spike thanks to component costs increasing by up to 50%
PC gaming sure ain't cheap.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Silent Hill: Townfall is the most Scottish game I've ever played and the most effective horror game I've seen in ages: 'It made sense for us to dig deep into our upbringings, into our past, and try and build a place that felt believable'
And not just because of the foul weather.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'That criticism is justified': Gamescom apologizes for its callous response to developer hardware thefts
Gamescom said it is "committed to jointly reviewing and further improving security," but doesn't mention any compensation for affected exhibitors.

author: PC Gamer
text:
In a sea of failed live service games, I'm shocked to see someone trying to make a MOBA
Project Zeta is trying to crack a near-impenetrable market.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Age Twisters is a simple yet charming spin on the co-op adventure that aims to feel like watching a Pixar movie
The puzzles won't stump you, but Piccolo Studios says they're not supposed to.

author: PC Gamer
text:
DLSS 5 is called 'DLSS Neural Rendering' in the NBA 2K27 graphics options, and I think I smell a rebrand of Nvidia's controversial graphics tech
It's all in a name. Well, some of it, anyway.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Sick of grinding for upgrade materials like leather and iron in Onimusha: Way of the Sword? Good news: you can buy a lot of them
With the souls you get from killing Genma, not cash money.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Arc Raiders' executive producer admits its developers 'couldn't keep pace with the players' and their need for content, but promises Frozen Trail as the answer
"What we want to do is spend more time building quality stuff."

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Blood of Dawnwalker's mods immediately scrap the time pressure mechanic, which is apparently a dealbreaker for some people
That didn't take much time.

author: PC Gamer
text:

Everyone's favourite cosy sim, now with gacha.

text:

author: PC Gamer
text:
I've found DLSS 5 can slash frame rates by up to 73% on an RTX 5080 gaming PC in NBA 2K27, and I'm wondering what kind of mega-rig would justify the performance hit
At what cost AI-enhanced graphics? Frames, it seems.

author: PC Gamer
text:
It's really starting to look like a new StarCraft game will be revealed at BlizzCon
Initial reports of a Nexon-developed shooter were met with doubt, but now something funky is happening with the StarCraft 2 website. And have you seen the BlizzCon schedule?

author: PC Gamer
text:

Gotta find revenue wherever you can, I guess.

text:
